issues.display_title: Issue #1860: feat(auth): Implement Keycloak Login API Endpoint (GT Token Exchange)
issues.main_description_html:
Summary

Add POST /v1/auth/keycloak-login endpoint to exchange a Keycloak access token for a GoThru login session (token & cookie).

Flow

  1. Token Verification: Validate the Keycloak token (signature & issuer).
  2. Account Matching: Find the user by Keycloak ID (keycloak_sub). If not linked yet, automatically link via matching email.
  3. Status Check: Ensure the account is active and the email is verified.
  4. Issue Session: Generate GoThru token and session cookie (matching /auth/login response format).

Notes

  • Applies to existing users (new user registration via Keycloak is handled separately).
  • Configuration: KEYCLOAK_BASE_URL and KEYCLOAK_REALM.

Acceptance Criteria

  • Valid token successfully logs in and returns GoThru token + cookie (200).
  • Invalid token is rejected (401).
  • Unregistered user is rejected (409).
  • Inactive or unverified account is rejected (422).
  • All unit tests pass.

Result

  • PR: Merged via #1867.
  • Verification: Successfully tested token exchange with Keycloak access token — returned HTTP 200 with valid GoThru JWT token and session cookie.
  • Tests: Unit test suite (KeycloakLoginActionTest) passed with 5/5 tests and 11 assertions.
  • Performance: Optimized JWKS certificate lookup with in-memory and app cache, reducing token validation overhead from ~60s to sub-second (<1s).
